概述

本模组提供了三十多种炮台，所有炮台都需要核心进行合成，这些核心分为三个类别和四个等级，升级需要消耗材料和击杀数。炮台可以通过装备道具或提升科技以进行强化。

 

游戏流程

首先，你可以在原版工作台合成“驱动核心（1级）” ，它可以用于合成一些初级的炮台。接下来，为了制作更强大的炮台，你需要在“核心升级台”中制作更高级的核心，这通常需要消耗击杀数（核心升级台内自带合成表和击杀数消耗提示）。你的炮台需要一个“计数器”才能记录击杀数。

制作一个“维修站”，损坏后的炮台可在维修站中修复，根据核心的类型消耗铁锭、铜锭或金锭。

制作一个“售货机”，在交易站你可以用钻石、金锭或小道具换取硬币，使用硬币进行随机抽奖，在交易站你可以用钻石、金锭或小道具换取硬币，使用硬币进行随机抽奖，但不包含下界核心系列炮台的道具。

制作一个“杂货铺”，在杂货铺你可以用金锭、绿宝石、地狱疣菌酱换取道具。

制作一个“研究台”。这意味着游戏进入到下一阶段，你将能够快速地提升炮台科技，包括炮台的基础攻击力、攻速、每秒回血和最大生命值。在“研究台”获取合成“超级计数器”的材料，“超级计数器”将会记录2倍的击杀数，同时提高炮台击杀敌人掉落（科技）奖励的概率。

制作一个“实验室”，它可以制作最高级的道具和护甲。

 

补充说明

  • 1.13.3版本，炮台终于被正确地设置为友好生物！
  • 如果你的炮台被破坏，存储的道具也会损毁，但护甲及护甲内储存的道具不会损毁；
  • 炮台的GUI内有2个按钮，第一个按钮为“攻击已知的敌对生物”，第二个按钮为“攻击所有生物，除了已知的友好生物和铁傀儡”；
  • 科技：炮台的基础攻击力、攻速、每秒回血、最大生命值和额外射程均通过数字世界规则实现调整，每项规则同时记录2项信息——“炮台当前提升”和“提升的上限”。强烈建议您打开“测试工具2”的GUI以确认它们的工作原理；注意：炮台攻击力=基础攻击力×科技×道具；
  • “手套”：这是专门用来储存和放置炮台的物品，它非常方便。手持该物品对炮台右键，它将同时储存炮台及其存储的物品。在方块上右键以放置炮台。“手套”的GUI内有2个按钮，第一个按钮是使附近30格内的炮台选择1个目标，第二个按钮是使炮台不再攻击一个实体，点击按钮后，潜行+右键以发射投掷物，投掷物命中实体后将会触发按钮的功能；
  • 手持炮台对“治疗光塔”右键，可以瞬间修复炮台；
  • “击杀数消耗倍数（Cost of kills）”：这是数字世界规则，调整“核心升级台”和“研究台”对击杀数的消耗，默认值为1；
  • “炮台击杀掉落奖励（Drop rewards）”：这是数字世界规则，炮台击杀敌人有概率掉落（科技）奖励，此规则用于调整其掉落概率；
  • 由于投掷物命中伤害自动取整，2.4.0版本后所有投掷物均改为命中后间接造成伤害，且造成伤害前会设置目标无敌时间为0；
  • 配置文件名为“silence's turrets”，在config文件夹中;
  • 你可以通过配置文件或游戏规则禁止敌对炮台的生成
  • 由于mcreator把生物类型都注册为monster，炮台被一些模组识别为敌对生物，导致炮台被攻击；
  • 敌对炮台可以通过游戏规则或配置文件中的[gamerules]禁止生成；
  • 我允许任何人借鉴本模组，包括所有模型和贴图，我无所谓。

 

    There are more than three dozen turrets, all of which require cores for synthesis, which are divided into three categories and four levels. First, you can synthesize "Driving Core level 1" in the crafting table, which can be used to synthesize some basic turrets. Next, in order to make more powerful turrets, you need to make more advanced cores in the "Core Upgrade Desk", which usually costs kills. 

    The negative red number in the GUI of the "Core Upgrade Desk" refers to the number of kills that need to be consumed, and the turret needs to be equipped with 1 "Counter" to start recording kills. The "Core Upgrade Desk" will then need to equip 1 "Counter" to get kills and consume them.

  • In version 1.13.3, the turrets are finally correctly set as friendly creatures!
  • Make a "Maintenance station" where damaged turrets can be repaired, consuming iron, gold, or copper ingots depending on the type of core.
  • Make a "Vending Machine" where you can exchange diamonds, gold ingots, or props for coins that are used in a random draw that includes the most valuable props (not available at the Variety Store). 
  • Make a "Variety Store" where you can exchange emeralds, gold ingots, and Hell Wart Sauce for props, which is the only way to get hellraiser's props.
  • Make a "research table". This means that as you move to the next stage of the game, you'll be able to quickly increase your turret technology, including its base attack power, attack speed, health regeneration per second, and max health. You can exchange any prop for a "Precision Components" in the "Research Table".
  • Make a "laboratory" where you can craft the highest level of props and armor.

 

  • If your turrets are destroyed, the props stored in it will also be destroyed.
  • There are 2 buttons in the turret's GUI, the first button is "Attack known monster entity", and the second button is "Attack all mob entities, except known friendly mobs and iron golems";
  • "Glove": This is a special item for storing and placing turrets, it is very convenient. Hold this item to right the turrets, it will also store the turrets and its chips, props. Right-click on the block to place a turret.There are 2 buttons in the GUI of "Glove", the first button is to make the turret within 30 blocks nearby select 1 target, the second button is to make the turret no longer attack an entity, after clicking the button, sneak + right click to fire a projectile, and the function of the button will be triggered when the projectile hits the entity;
  • Right-click on the "Healing Tower" while holding the turret to instantly repair the turret;
  • When using 'Test Tool 2', sneak + right-click to open the GUI and select a throwable with different functions, they will take effect when hitting MOBS.
  • The configuration file is named "silence's turrets" and is in the config folder.
  • Since mcreator registers all creature types as monsters, turrets are identified as hostile mobs by some mods, causing turrets to be attacked.
  • Hostile turrets can be disabled from spawning through game rules or configuration files.
  • I allow anyone to borrow from this mod, including all the models and textures, I don't care.
